text:
anya (AE): FYI — TeleHealthX POC asking for a special econ on their reserved GPU pool. Need deal-desk signoff.
anya (AE): Details: committed 16 GPUs (A100 equiv) for 12 months, want autoscale burst up to +50% for short windows (max 2h/day), asking for 40% off base commit and bill bursts at 1.6x base rate. Also asking 99.9% latency SLA during bursts.
sam (SE): @anya thanks. A few quick clarifiers: is the burst coming from our shared on-demand pool or they expect dedicated burst nodes?
sam (SE): If burst uses shared capacity, latency SLA during burst is risky unless we reserve capacity or pre-warm. Also KV cache warm-up adds ~100-300ms initially.
sam (SE): Example autoscale policy they'd want (pseudo):
```
{
  "min_replicas": 16,
  "max_replicas": 24, // +50% burst
  "scale_window": "5m",
  "prewarm": true
}
```
raul (Deal Desk): Ok. Need commercial inputs: target ARR, expected baseline monthly GPU-hours, and who owns the legal risk on SLA. Also list current list price per GPU-hour so I can model discount ladder.
anya (AE): TeleHealthX projected baseline ~11,000 GPU-hours/mo on commit. POC may ramp to 18k during burst days. ARR for 12mo commit ~ $1.2M list before discounts.
raul (Deal Desk): Thanks. Initial thoughts: 40% off base is steep for 16-unit commit; we could consider a structured concession: 25% off base, burst multiplier 1.5x, plus a capped burst-hours allowance (e.g., 120 hrs/mo). That keeps unit economics sane. Need finance sign-off for anything below 25%.
mike (SRE): From an ops side: if we want to meet a latency SLO during bursts we should either: (a) reserve extra warm nodes (effectively increase commit), or (b) accept a degraded latency SLO and provide a fallback model variant. Pre-warmed nodes reduce cold-start but cost more.
mike (SRE): Also watch KV cache behavior: if they scale from 16->24 often, cache misses spike and early token latency increases. Suggest explicit warmup windows or a traffic-shift plan for POC.
anya (AE): Customer prefers not to increase commit size right now. They're sensitive to cash. Can we offer a time-limited promo for POC only? e.g., 3-mo trial with higher burst allowance and lower discounts, then renegotiate for production?
raul (Deal Desk): We can do a POC promo: propose 3-mo promo with 30% off base, burst multiplier 1.5x, max 200 burst hrs in promo period, and a clause that production pricing will be renegotiated. Tell legal: SLA during promo is best-effort; no warranty for 99.9% during shared-burst.
legal-bot: Flag: any SLA change or special billing requires inclusion in SOW + legal review. If customer insists on 99.9% during bursts, we need Operations-Backed SLA and insurance sign-off.
sam (SE): Technical fallback we can offer to improve perceived latency: route high-priority traffic to a reserved micro-pool (small number of pre-warmed nodes) while best-effort traffic uses shared burst. That reduces customer pain without full commit increase.
anya (AE): TeleHealthX is ok with a POC promo. They want final terms by EOD Friday. I'll capture: 3-mo promo, 16 commit, 30% off base, burst 1.5x, promo burst cap 200 hrs, SLA best-effort. Can we get provisional yes?
raul (Deal Desk): Provisional yes from me for the promo, subject to finance ok and legal SOW language. @finance please confirm. If finance approves, I'll draft ratecard entries and the SOW snippet.
raul (Deal Desk): Action items: @anya send ARR calc + expected monthly hours spreadsheet; @sam add a short ops mitigation plan (pre-warm micro-pool + fallback). I'll queue deal-desk review and loop in legal.
anya (AE): Sending spreadsheet now, uploading security questionnaire separately. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
